mostWorthwhile.text: Making the glacier, valley and braided river was the most worthwhile passage: the combinations connected accumulating ice, gravity and sediment to a changing landscape.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying seasons with the mountain range was the least worthwhile decision; it failed, although the compatibility feedback usefully narrowed the options.

surprise.text: Clouds and mountains produced a rain shadow rather than the snow I expected, showing how one range can create contrasting climates.

arbitrary.text: Air tipping the planet felt symbolic rather than physically clear, although the subsequent explanation of axial tilt and seasons made its purpose clear.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how these contrasting landscapes support life; the glacier sequence and rain shadow made the world's processes engaging without presenting the combinations as literal recipes.
